dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (日医標準レセプトソフト); compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux; uses MCPAREA/SPAAREA linkage convention typical of ORCA
evidence: COPY MCPAREA / COPY ORCA-SPA / COPY LINKAREA
EXEC SQL absent, EXEC CICS absent
COPY copybooks with .INC extension typical of ORCA/GnuCOBOL

purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA standard medical receipt (claim) software – master menu / business-function selection screen (M00 master menu component)
purpose.summary: This is the master menu program (ORCGM00) of the JMA ORCA medical receipt system. It handles screen initialisation, navigation between sub-screens (M00, M01, M95, MVER, etc.), SPA (Scratchpad Area) management, system date setting, infection-report processing trigger, and operator authentication. It acts as the top-level dispatcher for the ORCA clinic management application.

notable_features: Heavy use of COPY copybooks (48 COPY statements) for SPA, screen layouts, and DB record layouts
LINKAGE SECTION with MCPAREA/SPAAREA/LINKAREA/SCRAREA – ORCA MCP framework
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS – uses proprietary MCP middleware
Extensive revision history in comments spanning 2000–2009
Shell script invocation area (infectiondata1.sh) for infection reporting
verdict.notes: File decoded as latin-1 but contains Japanese EUC-JP encoded comments, causing mojibake in the displayed text. This is normal for ORCA source files. The program is clearly production-grade JMA ORCA software, not a demo or student exercise. program_type set to online-cics as an approximation – ORCA uses its own MCP (Medical Care Platform) middleware rather than CICS, but the pattern is equivalent interactive online transaction processing.
